reason: The frozen v2 prompt requires non_empty, same_size, signal_all_finite, time_all_finite, and time_strictly_increasing.
Strict mode additionally requires time_monotonic_non_decreasing when it is present in Gold, although that field is not exposed in the v2 prompt.
Strict Held-out evaluation therefore labeled 47 execution-success cases as missing_validation even though the sampled reports contained every validation field visible to the model.

diagnostic-v2 checks only prompt-visible validation fields and normalizes the previously specified identity-to-target equivalent representation without changing numerical summaries or repairing incorrect visible values.
